written.title: Rockstar, Does GTA 6's Jason Show Full Hog Or Not? - Kotaku
written.description: What GamesRadar+, IGN and Kotaku reported about Want and Jason Duval on 5 October 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Want and Jason Duval, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## GamesRadar+, 5 October 2026

[GTA 6 story lead insists Rockstar "didn't want to make any kind of statement" with Jason's ex-military background](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-story-lead-insists-rockstar-didnt-want-to-make-any-kind-of-statement-with-jasons-ex-military-background/)

The outlet's own summary:

> A lot of Jason's actions are the result of his "material circumstances," says Rupert Humphries

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: "We didn't want to make any kind of statement with Jason's backstory," Humphries responds.

> Concerns for Jason and Lucia's happy ending aside, during a new interview with Love magazine, Rupert Humphries, GTA 6's senior vice president of narrative, is asked about Jason's backstory.

## IGN, 6 October 2026

[Rockstar Says GTA 6 Protagonist Jason Is 'Wired Differently,' Leading to Theories About Neurodivergency](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-fans-theorize-jason-may-be-the-franchises-first-neurodivergent-protagonist)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 fans have begun to speculate over whether or not Jason is the franchise's first outwardly neurodivergent protagonist.

> One specific comment that fans have latched on to is one where Humphries describes Jason as being "wired differently." "We didn’t want to make any kind of statement with Jason’s backstory," Humphries said in response to a question over whether or not Jason is a commentary on social class.

> In a recent interview with Love magazine, longtime Rockstar Games writer Rupert Humphries spoke about how the team designed Jason and Lucia's personalities.

> But a lot of this is up to the player to decide whether he needs to do that, or if it’s a choice he makes because he’s wired differently from other people." Fans have used this as a jumping-off point to reflect on some of the footage we've seen of Jason up to this point.

> During the extended gameplay reveal in August, fans were quick to point out that Jason is often seen missing social cues.

> Some fans have used this to speculate that Jason is actually neurodivergent.

> It's also possible that Jason is simply a very reserved, quiet guy.

> We likely won't get too much more insight into Jason, outside of maybe one more trailer, before launch.

> On top of murals and ads around major cities such as New York and Miami , Rockstar will also take over the Miami Heat for one night only and rebrand them as the Vice City Heat .

> They will play a regular-season NBA game against the Bucks on a Vice City-themed court in Miami on November 18.

## Kotaku, 7 October 2026

[Rockstar, Does GTA 6's Jason Show Full Hog Or Not? - Kotaku](https://kotaku.com/grand-theft-auto-6-gta6-jason-naked-nude-shower-scene-2000742015)

The outlet's own summary:

> I know I’ll see him naked, but just how naked?

> IGN ’s interview with Rockstar Head of Development and Co-Studio Head Rob Nelson makes mention of a point during their demo when they shifted from other playable character Lucia’s perspective to that of Jason, and when you do this, the other character might be in the middle of doing something like walking around, or, in this case, taking a shower.

> To answer the question of whether or not Jason shows hog in Grand Theft Auto 6 , the answer is that we still don’t know, but I would like to.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
